title: South Florida Nightlife Picks This Week
igCaption:
Fort Lauderdale gets the first stop this week.
Nov. 11 week, South Florida, venue prices vary

Sources: WSVN 7News, Sun Sentinel, Miami New Times, Secret Miami

#SouthFlorida #FortLauderdale #BocaRaton #Nightlife

scenes.text: Fort Lauderdale has a new seventies disco club, and Broward gets the first stop on this week’s going-out list.

location.name: Good Night John Boy Fort Lauderdale

scenes.text: Good Night John Boy has opened in Fort Lauderdale with seventies-themed decor, themed cocktails, and music inspired by that era. Sun Sentinel reported in March that Howl at the Moon had closed, and a seventies disco lounge was moving in.

scenes.text: Miami New Times also covered the opening on November sixth and called out disco ball cocktails. Motek By The Sea has opened at W Fort Lauderdale at 401 N. Fort Lauderdale Beach Blvd., with about 12,000 square feet and room for 315 diners. If you end up at Motek, NEAR shows who else shared the room.

scenes.text: Sun Sentinel’s November guide includes Savor Boca Experience and Sabores de las Américas. Boca has two more reasons to stay on the list this month.

scenes.text: Which one are you actually going to this week? Because half the people you pass on a night out stay strangers, NEAR is for the person you kept noticing but never got a name from.
